name: Dates with Loona
source:
Do you know Loona from "Helluva Boss"? In this game, she will reveal a new side of herself to you! You will have to show her what dating is like in our world. Or maybe she will tell you about dating in Hell~ Many sweet and naughty scenes await you!!

[From [url=https://furmirui.itch.io/dates-with-loona]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你认识《Helluva Boss》中的露娜吗？在这个游戏中，她将向你展现自己新的一面！你必须向她展示我们世界中的约会是什么样的。又或许她会告诉你地狱里的约会~许多甜蜜又调皮的场景等着你！！

[来自[url=https://furmirui.itch.io/dates-with-loona]Itch.io[/url]]
